info.description: Job-application tracker. Agents should prefer the pursuit CLI. Fetch this document when you need the HTTP shape; use `pursuit schema <command>` for one CLI command.
info.title: Pursuit

get.summary: list applications. status, company, fit, source, tag, q, stale, cursor, limit, sort, fields

post.summary: create an application

get.summary: lookup one application by posting URL. query url. 404 when the page is not tracked

post.summary: save the posting the user is viewing. dedupes by URL and creates status to_apply

patch.summary: update an application. status changes obey the approval rule

post.summary: attach resume_pdf, cover_letter, answers_json, form_snapshot, or confirmation
re-check this posting
enqueue prepare or submit work
append email_received, interview_scheduled, or note

get.summary: list interview rounds for an application

post.summary: add an interview round. stage is screening, interviewing, or final and defaults to the current stage. prep holds what to rehearse
one-step prepare: pull questions, draft answers, stop at awaiting_review or needs_input
attach a tag by name or tag_id

change status. a stage replaces the status and clears any outcome; waiting, needs_input, failed, rejected, withdrawn and ghosted are outcomes that keep the stage. approved requires the approve scope. submitting requires a stored approval
batch prepare or async enqueue
human approval. requires the approve scope, marks awaiting_review as approved, and enqueues submit. it does not submit a form
decline a prepared application. requires the approve scope. the application keeps its awaiting_review stage with outcome withdrawn and nothing is submitted
create a company

delete.summary: delete a company; version query or If-Match

patch.summary: update a company; body.version is required

get.summary: daily link sweep for Vercel Cron. requires Authorization Bearer CRON_SECRET, not a Pursuit token
list events. after plus wait_ms long-polls

post.summary: import the tracker CSV. Prepared maps to awaiting_review. Applied stays applied. The same posting_url updates the existing application
import a JSON array of postings
import markdown tables of roles as to_apply, deduped by URL
import the committed seed

delete.summary: delete an interview round; version query or If-Match

patch.summary: update an interview round; body.version is required. done true/false marks it done

get.summary: list checked postings. attention=true returns closed or changed. status is live, closed, or unknown

post.summary: sweep postings. one replica holds the advisory lock

get.summary: applicant profile: standing answers as a map, for the browser extension

post.summary: lease the next work item. replicas use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED on Postgres
finish leased work and set the resulting status
extend a lease
create a role
set a standing answer. profile values also load from PURSUIT_PROFILE
create a tag
create a token; secret is returned once
register a webhook
